market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Front-month WTI settled near $99.93 on Apr 28, 2026 after seven straight up sessions amid US-Iran tensions and a war scenario. To touch $80 settle by end of June requires a 20% drop in ~2 months, which would need rapid de-escalation and resumed OPEC+ supply (UAE leaving May 1). Possible if diplomacy succeeds quickly but not a base case while geopolitical risk premium is rising. Implied 0.50 looks too high vs my 0.20.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of resolution of US-Iran standoff and any rapid OPEC+ supply response
